body.zh-Hant: 彼得 1844年7月11日（儒略曆6月29日）生於貝爾格勒，父親是統治至1848年的亞歷山大親王。1858年父親被迫退位後，他此後約45年流亡，在巴黎受教育，就讀聖西爾軍校，並翻譯穆勒的《論自由》。普法戰爭（1870–71）期間他匿名以中尉身分參戰並獲榮譽軍團勳章；1875年波士尼亞的塞爾維亞人起義反抗鄂圖曼時，他回到巴爾幹，領導一支游擊隊。1883年他遷居蒙特內哥羅的采蒂涅，娶了尼古拉國王19歲的女兒佐爾卡。
body.en: Petar was born in Belgrade on 11 July 1844 (29 June in the Julian calendar), the son of Prince Alexander, who ruled until 1848. When his father was forced to step down in 1858, he lived in exile for the next 45 years, was educated in Paris, studied at the Saint-Cyr military academy and translated John Stuart Mill's On Liberty. In the Franco-Prussian War of 1870-71 he took part anonymously as a lieutenant and received the Legion of Honour; when the Serbs in Bosnia rose against the Ottomans in 1875 he returned to the Balkans and led a guerrilla band. In 1883 he moved to Cetinje in Montenegro and married King Nikola's 19-year-old daughter Zorka.

body.zh-Hant: 1903年6月10日夜，亞歷山大·奧布雷諾維奇國王與王后在宮中被軍官槍殺；彼得 當時帶著子女度假，似與政變無關。貝爾格勒的國民議會請他接任王位，他於1903年成為塞爾維亞國王，並在1904年9月21日加冕。英國因弒君者未受懲處而中斷外交關係，俄國則成為塞爾維亞最親近的盟友。
body.en: On the evening of 10 June 1903 King Alexander Obrenović and his queen were shot by officers inside the palace; Petar was on holiday with his children and apparently had nothing to do with the coup. The National Assembly in Belgrade asked him to take the throne, and he became King of Serbia in 1903 and was crowned on 21 September 1904. Britain broke off diplomatic relations because the guilty went unpunished, while Russia became Serbia's closest ally.

heading.zh-Hant: 黃金時代與巴爾幹戰爭
heading.en: The golden age and the Balkan Wars

body.zh-Hant: 1904至1914年被視為塞爾維亞的「黃金時代」：1903年憲法以比利時憲法為範本，議會制首次有效運作；貝爾格勒高等學校1905年升格為大學。塞爾維亞與保加利亞簽訂貿易協定後，奧地利於1906年禁止進口塞爾維亞貨物，這場封鎖被稱為「豬戰」；1908年奧匈併吞波赫使關係更緊張。1912至1913年兩次巴爾幹戰爭後塞爾維亞取得馬其頓與科索沃的大部分，他獲得「解放者」的尊號。1914年春，他因健康原因讓兒子亞歷山大出任攝政。
body.en: The years 1904-1914 are remembered as Serbia's golden age: the Constitution of 1903 was modelled on the Belgian one, and for the first time a parliamentary system functioned; the Belgrade college was upgraded to a university in 1905. When Serbia concluded a trade agreement with Bulgaria, Austria reacted in 1906 by banning imports of Serbian goods, and the blockade was called the Pig War; when Austria-Hungary annexed Bosnia-Herzegovina in 1908 relations grew more tense. After the Balkan Wars of 1912-1913 Serbia gained most of Macedonia and Kosovo, and he received the honorary name the Liberator. In spring 1914 he let his son Alexander take over as regent for reasons of health.

heading.zh-Hant: 世界大戰、新王國與逝世
heading.en: The World War, the new kingdom and death

body.zh-Hant: 1915至1916年冬，塞爾維亞軍隊穿越阿爾巴尼亞山區撤退，國王乘坐擔架，盟軍把他和倖存的士兵運往科孚。1918年12月1日，他在貝爾格勒被宣布為新成立的塞爾維亞人、克羅埃西亞人和斯洛維尼亞人王國的國王，由攝政亞歷山大主持；他本人留在國外，直到1919年夏。丹麥 Lex 條目指出，他雖於1918年12月1日成為國王，實際攝政者仍是兒子，直到他去世。他於1921年8月16日在貝爾格勒逝世，葬於托波拉附近的奧普萊納茨。
body.en: In the winter of 1915-1916 the Serbian army had to retreat through the mountains of Albania to the coast, with the king in a carrying chair; the allies transported him and the surviving soldiers to Corfu. On 1 December 1918 he was proclaimed king of the new Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes in Belgrade, an act carried out by the prince regent Alexander; Petar himself stayed abroad until the summer of 1919. The Danish Lex entry notes that although he became king on 1 December 1918, his son was the real regent until Petar's death. He died in Belgrade on 16 August 1921 and was buried at Oplenac near Topola.

people.name: Eleazar López Contreras
people.nameZh: 埃萊亞薩爾·洛佩斯·孔特雷拉斯

heading.en: Birth and entry into the army

body.zh-Hant: 洛佩斯·孔特雷拉斯 1883年5月5日生於塔奇拉州的奎尼克亞。父親是上校曼努埃爾·馬里亞·洛佩斯·特雷霍，他出生時即喪父，由舅父神父費爾南多·馬里亞·孔特雷拉斯負責教養。1899年5月24日他向西普里亞諾·卡斯特羅將軍請纓，次日仍加入向聖克里斯托瓦爾進軍的部隊，6月2日被任命為解放者營副官，軍旅生涯由此開始。
body.en: López Contreras was born at Queniquea in the state of Táchira on 5 May 1883. His father was Colonel Manuel María López Trejo; he was fatherless from the moment of his birth, and his maternal uncle, the priest Fernando María Contreras, took charge of his instruction and education. On 24 May 1899 he offered his services to General Cipriano Castro; he joined the troop movement on San Cristóbal the next day, and on 2 June was named adjutant of the Libertador battalion, which began his military life.

body.zh-Hant: 1900年1月他任共和國總統的副官；1914年2月重返現役，任里瓦斯第17營第一指揮官，1919年被任命為「作戰處長」（director de guerra），並主張發展軍事航空。1928年4月7日聖卡洛斯兵營叛亂時，他趕到現場，僅憑號令聲就接管兵營。1930年7月底，戈麥斯任命他暫代陸軍參謀長（jefe del Estado Mayor del ejército）。
body.en: In January 1900 he was aide-de-camp to the President of the Republic; in February 1914 he returned to active service as first commander of the Rivas No. 17 battalion, and in 1919 he was named director de guerra (director of war), from which post he proposed developing military aviation. During the San Carlos barracks uprising of 7 April 1928 he went to the scene and took the barracks with the sole force of his voice of command. At the end of July 1930 Gómez named him, on an interim basis, chief of the army general staff.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年4月22日，他被任命為代理陸軍與海軍部長，頂替因健康原因赴歐洲的部長托比亞斯·烏里韋將軍。戈麥斯被指定為1931至1936年的總統後，他於1931年7月13日正式出任陸軍與海軍部長，任職至1935年12月17日。任內他把軍事學校與海軍學校合併為單一機構，設立軍事圖書館，並推動軍事航空。
body.en: On 22 April 1931 he was named interim Minister of War and Navy while the titular minister, General Tobías Uribe, travelled to Europe for health reasons. After General Juan Vicente Gómez was designated to exercise the presidency from 1931 to 1936, López Contreras was named Minister of War and Navy on 13 July 1931, a post he held until 17 December 1935. In office he merged the Military and Naval schools into a single institute, gave it a military library, and gave impetus to military aviation.

body.zh-Hant: 辭典載明，1935年12月17日胡安·比森特·戈麥斯逝世，洛佩斯·孔特雷拉斯 被選為代理總統（presidente encargado），至1936年4月19日國會選他為1936至1943年任期的憲法總統。他在首次咨文即宣布要把總統任期由7年縮短為5年，此事在1936年7月16日的憲法修正中確立。1941年5月5日，他把權力交給伊薩亞斯·梅迪納·安加里塔將軍。
body.en: The dictionary records that on 17 December 1935 Juan Vicente Gómez died and López Contreras was elected acting president (presidente encargado), until 19 April 1936, when Congress elected him constitutional president for the 1936-1943 term. In his first message he announced his wish to cut the presidential term from 7 to 5 years, which was sanctioned in the constitutional reform of 16 July 1936. On 5 May 1941 he handed over power to General Isaías Medina Angarita.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年10月18日政變推翻梅迪納政府後，他被拘捕、驅逐並受審，旅居哥倫比亞與美國。1951年他回到加拉加斯，過著不問政事的退休生活。他1973年1月2日在加拉加斯逝世，享年90歲，生前為終身參議員。
body.en: After the coup d'état of 18 October 1945 against the Medina government he was arrested, expelled and put on trial, and went to live in Colombia and the United States. In 1951 he returned to live in Caracas, retired from all activity. He died in Caracas on 2 January 1973, at the age of 90, as a senator for life.

body.zh-Hant: Ruijs de Beerenbrouck 1873年12月1日生於魯爾蒙德，信奉羅馬天主教。1892年9月28日至1895年12月17日他在萊登大學修習法學，並以論文取得博士學位；1896年起在馬斯垂克擔任律師與訴訟代理人，至1901年8月1日，之後轉任馬斯垂克的檢察機關公務員，至1905年10月1日。
body.en: Ruijs de Beerenbrouck was born in Roermond on 1 December 1873 and was a Roman Catholic. He studied law at Leiden University from 28 September 1892 to 17 December 1895, graduating with a doctorate on a dissertation. From 1896 until 1 August 1901 he practised as an advocate and procureur in Maastricht, and he then served in the public prosecution service at Maastricht until 1 October 1905.

heading.zh-Hant: 眾議員與比利時難民專員
heading.en: Member of the Tweede Kamer and refugee commissioner

body.zh-Hant: 1905年9月19日至1909年9月21日，以及1909年12月7日至1918年5月16日，他代表古爾彭選區出任眾議員（Tweede Kamer）。傳記稱他在眾議員任內主要處理法律與勞工問題。1914年10月11日至1918年5月16日，他同時擔任政府的比利時難民專員。
body.en: He sat in the Tweede Kamer for the Gulpen district from 19 September 1905 to 21 September 1909 and again from 7 December 1909 to 16 May 1918. The biography says that as a member he dealt mainly with legal and labour matters. From 11 October 1914 to 16 May 1918 he was also the government commissioner for the Belgian refugees.

heading.zh-Hant: 林堡省專員與第一個內閣
heading.en: Commissaris in Limburg and the first cabinet

body.zh-Hant: 1918年5月16日至9月8日，他任林堡省女王專員。1918年9月9日起他擔任內政大臣（至1923年1月1日），並主持部長會議（至1925年8月3日；至1922年9月26日形式上為臨時主席）。傳記稱他的第一個內閣面對糧食短缺與德皇逃往荷蘭等問題，並在1918年11月以八小時工作日與婦女選舉權等改革承諾回應特羅爾斯特拉的革命企圖。
body.en: From 16 May to 8 September 1918 he was Commissaris of the Queen in Limburg. From 9 September 1918 he was Minister of the Interior (until 1 January 1923) and chaired the council of ministers (until 3 August 1925, formally as temporary chairman until 26 September 1922). The biography says his first cabinet faced problems such as food scarcity and the flight of the German Kaiser to the Netherlands, and that in November 1918 he answered Troelstra's attempted revolution by announcing reforms (the eight-hour day, women's suffrage).

body.zh-Hant: 1925年9月17日至1929年8月10日，他擔任眾議院議長。1925年11月7日至1929年8月，他任天主教各選區總聯盟（Algemeene Bond van Roomsch-Katholieke Rijkskiesvereenigingen）主席；該組織自1926年3月26日起稱羅馬天主教國家黨（RKSP）。1927年7月25日，他獲國務大臣（minister van staat）頭銜，持續到1936年4月17日。
body.en: From 17 September 1925 to 10 August 1929 he was Speaker of the Tweede Kamer. From 7 November 1925 to August 1929 he chaired the Algemeene Bond van Roomsch-Katholieke Rijkskiesvereenigingen, which has been called the Roomsch-Katholieke Staatspartij (RKSP) since 26 March 1926. From 25 July 1927 he held the title of minister of state, until 17 April 1936.

body.zh-Hant: 1929年8月10日起，他第三次主持部長會議（至1933年5月26日），同時任內政與農業大臣；1932年5月1日起職稱改為內政大臣，至1933年5月25日。1933年4月20日至5月25日，他並代理外交大臣。傳記指出，世界經濟危機在他的第三個內閣期間爆發。1933年5月31日起他再任眾議院議長，直到1936年4月17日於烏特勒支去世。
body.en: From 10 August 1929 he chaired the council of ministers for the third time (until 26 May 1933) while serving as Minister of the Interior and Agriculture; from 1 May 1932 the post was titled Minister of the Interior, until 25 May 1933. From 20 April to 25 May 1933 he was also acting Minister of Foreign Affairs. The biography notes that the world economic crisis broke out during his third cabinet. From 31 May 1933 he was again Speaker of the Tweede Kamer, until his death in Utrecht on 17 April 1936.
